newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian NSW state appoints new Treasury chief.
newsitem.headline: Australian NSW state appoints new Treasury chief.

text.p: The New South Wales (NSW) state government has appointed John Pierce to head the NSW Treasury.
Pierce has been the acting secretary of Treasury since the departure of Michael Lambert to the private sector in January, NSW Treasurer Michael Egan said.
Egan said he has recommended the appointment to the NSW governor for the five-year post following an exhaustive domestic and international search for candidates within Australia and overseas.
"Mr Pierce not only has the skills and experience needed for the top job, he has a mile of energy and he really knows where he wants to lead the Treasury," Egan added.
